page_title: Keploy — Open-Source AI API & Unit Testing for Developers

sources.entry: Keploy - A developer-centric backend testing tool which makes backend tests with built-in-mocks faster than unit tests, from user traffic, making it easy to use, powerful, and extensible. #opensource

summary.name: Keploy
summary.one_liner: Keploy is an open-source testing tool that records real application API traffic and dependency calls, then turns them into editable tests and mocks that replay against new builds to catch regressions.
use_cases: Generate regression tests from real application traffic
Mock databases, queues, caches and external APIs during tests
Verify AI- or human-written code changes in CI before merge
Test backend services in Kubernetes without modifying application code
Create edge-case tests from API schemas and recorded flows
summary.what_it_does: Keploy captures incoming requests and outgoing dependency calls using eBPF and network-level interception, without requiring application code changes. It converts the captured behavior into editable tests and mocks, then replays them against new builds to detect response, schema, contract, and performance regressions. It can also use API schemas and application context to generate additional edge cases and connected flows beyond the original recordings. Tests can run locally, in CI/CD pipelines, or across Kubernetes.
notable: Records traffic via eBPF and network-level interception with no application code changes
Auto-generates mocks for databases, queues, caches and external APIs from real behavior
Core local record-and-replay platform is Apache 2.0 open source
Can generate extra edge-case tests from API schemas and application context
caveats: Recording from Kubernetes, staging, and production, plus governance, security controls, dashboards, and support, are enterprise capabilities (paid tier implied)
Page does not specify enterprise pricing
